name: Gerda
source:
Step into the role of the titular Gerda, as you set on a quest to unravel the sudden disappearance of your childhood friend, Kay. Carry out your impromptu investigation, as you engage with a tapestry of characters in conversations, piece together scattered clues, and slowly unravel a web of secrets and lies.  

[From [url=https://szmatt.itch.io/gerda]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演格爾達，追查青梅竹馬的好友加伊突然失蹤的原因。這場調查來得倉促：你得和形形色色的人交談，把零散的線索拼在一起，慢慢解開那些相互交織的秘密與謊言。

（來源：[url=https://szmatt.itch.io/gerda]itch.io[/url]）
